platform.name: FreedomNex
platform.description: A digital sanctuary for Islamic philosophy, classical sciences, spiritual ethics, and timeless wisdom inspired by the Abbasid Bayt al-Hikma.

heroWisdom.english: Read! In the name of your Lord who created.
heroWisdom.pageTwoEnglish: My Lord, increase me in knowledge and understanding.

pillars.title: Qur'an & Classical Exegesis
pillars.summary: Exploring linguistic nuance, thematic coherence, and timeless hermeneutics across classical and contemporary exegesis.
pillars.details: Delve into the foundational text of Islam through the analytical lenses of classical mufassirun (Al-Tabari, Al-Zamakhshari, Ibn Kathir, Al-Razi) alongside modern linguistic and thematic methodologies.

pillars.title: Hadith & Prophetic Seerah
pillars.summary: Rigorous critical transmission methodology, moral archetype analysis, and the historical life of the Prophet ﷺ.
pillars.details: Study the science of Isnad (chains of transmission) and Matn (content critique), examining how ethical paradigms and living traditions were rigorously documented and preserved.

pillars.title: Islamic Philosophy & Kalam
pillars.summary: The dialogue between rational inquiry and revelation from Al-Kindi, Al-Farabi, and Ibn Sina to Al-Ghazali and Ibn Rushd.
pillars.details: Investigate the golden intellectual debates of the Abbasid and Andalusian eras: the nature of existence, epistemology, divine attributes, causality, and the harmony of reason (Aql) and revelation (Naql).

pillars.title: Sciences & Golden Age Heritage
pillars.summary: Pioneering breakthroughs in astronomy, optics, algebra, medicine, and architecture at Bayt al-Hikma and beyond.
pillars.details: Discover how the synthesis of world knowledge in Baghdad, Cairo, Córdoba, and Samarkand sparked revolutionary advancements in empirical science by Ibn al-Haytham, Al-Khwarizmi, Al-Biruni, and Al-Zahrawi.

pillars.title: Ethics, Tazkiyah & Hikmah
pillars.summary: Inner cultivation, virtue ethics, philosophical psychology, and the purification of the heart.
pillars.details: A contemplative exploration of moral virtue and spiritual realization, drawing from classical treatises of Akhlaq (Miskawayh, Al-Raghib al-Isfahani) and inward purification (Al-Ghazali's Ihya Ulum al-Din).

pillars.title: Contemporary Thought & Dialogue
pillars.summary: Engaging today's philosophical questions, technology ethics, artificial intelligence, and civilizational renewal.
pillars.details: Applying the depth of classical Islamic wisdom to modern existential inquiries: bioethics, environmental stewardship (Khilafah), algorithmic ethics, and fostering constructive cross-cultural discourse.

wisdomQuotes.arabic: يُؤْتِي الْحِكْمَةَ مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ وَمَن يُؤْتَ الْحِكْمَةَ فَقَدْ أُوتِيَ خَيْرًا كَثِيرًا ۗ وَمَا يَذَّكَّرُ إِلَّا أُولُو الْأَلْبَابِ
wisdomQuotes.translation: He grants wisdom to whom He pleases; and whoever is granted wisdom has certainly been given an abundance of good. But none will remember except those of understanding.
wisdomQuotes.context: The divine definition of 'Hikmah' (deep discernment combining true knowledge with virtuous conduct).

wisdomQuotes.arabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
wisdomQuotes.translation: Whoever treads a path in pursuit of knowledge, Allah will facilitate for them a path to Paradise.
wisdomQuotes.context: The fundamental sanctification of intellectual seeking and continuous learning in Islamic tradition.

wisdomQuotes.arabic: يَنْبَغِي لَنَا أَلَّا نَسْتَحِيَ مِنَ اسْتِحْسَانِ الْحَقِّ وَاقْتِنَاءِ الْحَقِّ مِنْ أَيْنَ أَتَى
wisdomQuotes.translation: We ought not to be embarrassed of appreciating the truth and of obtaining it wherever it comes from, even if it comes from earlier generations and foreign peoples.
wisdomQuotes.source: Abu Yusuf Ya'qub ibn Ishaq Al-Kindi — Fi al-Falsafah al-Ula (On First Philosophy, c. 840 CE)
wisdomQuotes.context: The foundational manifesto of the Baghdad House of Wisdom, establishing universal intellectual open-mindedness.

wisdomQuotes.arabic: الْعِلْمُ بِلَا عَمَلٍ جُنُونٌ، وَالْعَمَلُ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ لَا يَكُونُ
wisdomQuotes.translation: Knowledge without action is insanity, and action without knowledge is vanity.
wisdomQuotes.source: Imam Abu Hamid Al-Ghazali — Ayyuha al-Walad (Letter to a Disciple)
wisdomQuotes.context: The inseparable union between intellectual mastery and moral manifestation in daily conduct.

wisdomQuotes.arabic: الْوَهْمُ نِصْفُ الدَّاءِ، وَالِاطْمِئْنَانُ نِصْفُ الدَّوَاءِ، وَالصَّبْرُ أَوَّلُ خُطُوَاتِ الشِّفَاءِ
wisdomQuotes.translation: Anxiety is half the disease, tranquility is half the remedy, and patience is the first step toward healing.
wisdomQuotes.source: Ibn Sina (Avicenna) — Al-Qanun fi al-Tibb (The Canon of Medicine)
wisdomQuotes.context: Holistic psychosomatic wisdom linking mental serenity, emotional balance, and physical well-being.

wisdomQuotes.arabic: الَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ قِيَامًا وَقُعُودًا وَعَلَىٰ جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ
wisdomQuotes.translation: Those who remember Allah standing, sitting, and lying on their sides, and contemplate the creation of the heavens and the earth.
wisdomQuotes.context: The pairing of spiritual remembrance with deep cosmological contemplation and scientific curiosity.

learningPaths.title: Foundations of Hikmah: The Classical Mind
learningPaths.description: An essential journey into the core epistemology of classical Islamic thought, tracing how reason and revelation flourished together.
modules: Epistemology: Sources of Knowledge in Islam

learningPaths.title: The Great Debates: Kalam vs. Falsafah
learningPaths.description: Examine the rigorous metaphysical dialogues between the Mu'tazilites, Ash'arites, Avicennian philosophers, and Ghazalian critique.
modules: Ibn Rushd's Doctrine of Double Truth Explored

learningPaths.title: The Golden Age of Discovery & Empirical Method
learningPaths.description: Discover how Muslim polymaths established the modern empirical scientific method through optics, astronomy, medicine, and geometry.
modules: Ibn al-Haytham's Book of Optics & Experimentation
Bimaristans: The Birth of the Modern Hospital System

learningPaths.title: Contemplative Ethics & Modern Technology
learningPaths.description: A pioneering course synthesizing ancient Islamic moral psychology with modern challenges in artificial intelligence and transhumanism.
modules: The Fitrah (Human Nature) in the Age of Algorithms

timeline.title: Foundation of Baghdad
timeline.description: Caliph Al-Mansur establishes Madinat al-Salam (The City of Peace), commissioning the first major palace libraries and intellectual circles.

timeline.title: The Golden Peak of Bayt al-Hikma
timeline.description: Caliph Al-Ma'mun elevates the House of Wisdom into the world's preeminent academy, observatory, and translation epicenter.

timeline.title: The Empirical Revolution
timeline.description: Al-Hasan Ibn al-Haytham pioneers the modern scientific method in Cairo, formulating controlled experimental verification in 'Kitab al-Manazir'.

timeline.title: The Ghazalian Synthesis
timeline.description: Imam Abu Hamid Al-Ghazali harmonizes rational jurisprudence, spiritual psychology, and intellectual epistemology in 'Ihya Ulum al-Din'.

timeline.title: FreedomNex House Of Wisdom
timeline.description: Reviving the universal spirit of open inquiry, moral clarity, and timeless contemplation for the digital generation.
